# Subway Seat for Procreate

A Procreate palette per flavor with all 26 colors in role order: grounds, text, then accents. Procreate palettes don't carry swatch names.

[Procreate](https://procreate.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/procreate/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.swatches`](Subway%20Seat.swatches) | `Procreate (open the file on your iPad)` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.swatches`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.swatches) | `Procreate (open the file on your iPad)` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.swatches`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.swatches) | `Procreate (open the file on your iPad)` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your iPad:

```text
Open Subway Seat.swatches from Files or AirDrop; it lands in Colors ▸ Palettes.
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your iPad:

```text
Open Subway Seat Tunnel.swatches from Files or AirDrop; it lands in Colors ▸ Palettes.
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your iPad:

```text
Open Subway Seat Enamel.swatches from Files or AirDrop; it lands in Colors ▸ Palettes.
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `Procreate (open the file on your iPad)`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
